messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Multiple GPU-health alerts in us-west-2-A - inference-pool: 3x error rate, autoscaler failing to reach target capacity. Rolling GPU-reset events observed.

alice: saw this, getting paged. any spike in traffic?

ben: traffic steady. errors look HW-related - seeing node-level GPU resets and kernel GPU remove/adds.

leo: copying a quick dmesg snippet from node gpu-node-42: 
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCIe) 62, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679012] NVRM: GPU Reset detected on GPU 0
[ 12346.012345] nvidia: Uncorrectable ECC error on device 0
```

maria: confirmed on two other nodes in the same rack. Pod evictions + kubelet restarting gpu driver.

ops-oncall: impact: inference-prod latency + errors for hosted customers in us-west-2. Capacity showing -18% on the pool, autoscale keep failing with new nodes reporting GPU-faults and being drained.

alice: can we isolate to a maintenance domain? we should stop scheduling inference jobs to that rack.

ben: cordoning nodes now in us-west-2-A rack-7. running `kubectl cordon gpu-node-{40..48}` and `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` for affected nodes.

leo: quick check of inventory shows these machines are same hardware revision, same firmware. suspect driver/firmware incompatibility + possible thermal/power anomaly.

maria: ops: can you pull out vendor telemetry? iLO/IPMI shows multiple thermal warnings spanning past 24h on rack-7.

ops-oncall: yes grabbing logs and opening a case with hardware vendor. tagging infra.

monitoring-bot: NOTE: fallback routing enabled for inference-prod -> inference-fallback-model (lower perf but keeps requests alive).

alice: thanks. start gradual replacement from spare pool to keep capacity up. avoid bulk replacements in same AZ at once.

ben: agreed. bringing up spare nodes in us-west-2-B and draining one-by-one in A. Patch plan: disable autoupdates for driver, roll driver to 525.116 (known-stable) on replaced hosts.

leo: runbook step executed: `sudo nvidia-smi --reset -i 0` on a flaky host briefly restored GPU but reset recurred. Will proceed to replace cards where available.

maria: note for billing: spins a few replacements and vendor RMA - estimate +$6k this month if we pull spares from other pools. Ops, pls flag finance if RMA costs confirmed.

ops-oncall: incident ticket created: INC-2026-438. Owner: alice. Timeline: start remediation now, postmortem to follow.

alice: current mitigation plan summary: 1) cordon rack-7 nodes 2) route traffic to fallback within AZ then to other AZs 3) bring spares from us-west-2-B 4) replace affected hardware / vendor RMA 5) hold driver upgrades until patch validated.

ben: rolling replacements started. will post node-by-node status in this thread. :wrench:

leo: adding monitoring alert tweak: suppress noisy GPU-reset alerts for nodes that are cordoned/replaced to reduce noise.

maria: creating postmortem template and collecting logs (dmesg, nvidia-smi, ipmi) — sharing s3 link when ready.

ops-oncall: updating customer incident page with status - ETA next update +30m.

alice: good work team. escalate to oncall infra if replacements exceed 6 hosts.

ben: first three nodes replaced, capacity recovered ~6%. continuing.

leo: keeping this open until vendor confirms root cause. will move to postmortem after stabilization. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
